title: Action Log Entry
description: One record per action the agent takes, per the system prompt's 'Log every action taken (reply sent, ad launched, lead contacted) for review.'

actor.description: Whether the agent took this action autonomously or a human approved/took it.

reference.description: Foreign keys into the relevant record, e.g. thread_id, campaign_id, lead id.

approval_threshold_applied.description: Which rule in docs/approval-thresholds.md gated this action, if any.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary of what happened.

details.description: Action-specific payload (e.g. reply text, campaign brief, lead score).
